description: A rewrite or major amendment of a zoning or development code: diagnosis, outline, module drafts, the map, public review and adoption.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
A code update is drafted in modules because reviewing a whole code at once produces no useful comment. The module drafts are deliberately separate deliverables.
The map is the part the public reacts to. Releasing standards without the map that applies them produces review comments about the wrong thing.
Adoption procedure, notice and hearing requirements for a code change are set locally and by state or national law. None are stated here.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Code diagnosis report
deliverables.summary: What the current code blocks, allows, contradicts or leaves ambiguous, tested against the adopted plan.

deliverables.title: Annotated outline of the new code
deliverables.summary: The structure of the new code, agreed before any section is written.

deliverables.title: Module drafts — zones, uses and development standards
deliverables.summary: The substantive modules drafted for review one at a time.

deliverables.title: Administration and procedures module
deliverables.summary: Applications, review paths, decision bodies, appeals and nonconformities.

deliverables.title: Draft zoning map and consistency review
deliverables.summary: The map as it would apply, with every proposed change checked against the adopted plan.

deliverables.title: Public review draft code
deliverables.summary: The assembled code and map released together for public review.

deliverables.title: Final code and map for adoption
deliverables.summary: The draft revised after review, in the form the adopting body will act on.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, schedule and the review structure confirmed.

milestones.title: Stakeholder interviews complete
milestones.summary: Applicants, staff, builders and neighbourhood groups describe how the current code behaves in practice.

milestones.title: Staff working sessions on the modules
milestones.summary: The people who will administer the code test each module against real cases.

milestones.title: Advisory body workshops
milestones.summary: The recommending body works through the draft code and map.

milestones.title: Public review of the draft code opens
milestones.summary: The draft code and map are released for comment.

milestones.title: Public hearings on the code and map
Adoption of the code and map
milestones.summary: The governing body adopts the new code.
